body.x: Changes in bowel habits can reflect changes in health, yet few people keep any record of them.

IZEN, a bidet maker based in Gimpo, plans to put that record in the bathroom itself. Led by CEO Myungjae Yu, the company is exhibiting at KES 2026 with the IZEN x KANARIA HEALTH AI Smart Bidet, which is scheduled for release, along with Inclean R Modern, an IoT smart bidet and Eco Air.

The AI Smart Bidet collects and analyzes bowel movement data automatically, detects changes in health with AI and lets users review their history and abnormality alerts in an app. Inclean R Modern uses a patented nozzle designed to support smoother bowel movements, and adds fragrance deodorization and massage functions. The IoT Smart Bidet connects to SmartThings, so users can set self-cleaning nozzle cycles, check filter status and control key functions from a smartphone. Eco Air mixes water and air for its air bubble cleansing system and has one-touch automatic nozzle cleaning, a water-resistant design and a full stainless-steel nozzle. IZEN's nozzle technology has earned medical device certification from Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS).

Established in 2003, IZEN has spent more than 20 years developing and making electronic bidets. It supplies ODM and OEM products to leading bathroom and home appliance brands in Korea and exports to about 30 countries in North America, Europe, Japan and the rest of Asia. The company began exporting to the United States and Europe around 2006, set up a U.S. subsidiary in 2008, and later obtained U.S. UPC certification, supplied major U.S. retailers, expanded on Amazon and entered Japan's duty-free retail market. Its annual sales passed KRW 50 billion (about USD 36 million) in 2024, and it received the USD 10 Million Export Tower Award and a KOTRA Award for Contribution to Trade in 2020.

IZEN recorded about USD 12 million in exports in 2024 and USD 11 million in 2025, and exports this year had passed USD 9 million through September. It supplies more than 50 customers in 30 countries and runs in-house testing facilities and a smart factory-based production and quality management system. It plans to strengthen customized product development and stable supply in North America, Europe and Japan, enter new markets selectively according to regional demand and regulation, and keep advancing production automation and digital healthcare research.

KES 2026, the 57th Korea Electronics Show, runs Oct. 13 to Oct. 16 at COEX Halls A and B in Seoul. Alongside the co-located XR & Spatial Computing Show, the event features X-SPACE 2026, a special exhibition covering digital twins, industrial XR, spatial intelligence, XR devices and spatial computing platforms. The Innovation Awards ceremony takes place on Oct. 13.
